adaptations.change: codex-native dispatch fixture: the settled-dispatch ledger row is written under codex's own `outcome.dispatch.v2` typed acknowledgement contract (`_dispatch_records`), not Claude's v1 `kind: dispatch` row; the mechanism is mirrored, the record shape is codex's (KTD3)
`_registry_path` now wraps `store.root` in `Path(...)`; the reconcile sweep's `store_resolver` may return a store whose root is a plain string, and `read_registry_strict` needs a real Path

scope adaptation beyond the row's original planned targets: `prune` gained the `lease_authority` parameter and the pre-graph-mutation `prevalidate_reap_authority` arm. Without it, arming leases in the worktree registry would make an authority-free `prune` raise `WorktreeAuthorityError` AFTER `_commit` had already mutated the spec, leaving a pruned graph pointing at an unreapable worktree. Claude carries this arm at `outcome_decompose.py:282-309` (b464d090); the port is a regression fix, not new behavior

`test_planned_artifacts_not_yet_written_resolve_to_a_real_codex_directory` pinned an exact pending list naming `plugins/saga/tests/test_outcome_worktrees.py`; U5 creating that module made the pinned fact permanently stale. Retired to `test_planned_artifacts_resolve_to_a_real_codex_directory`, which keeps the KTD6 wrong-tree directory guard and adds the stronger `is_file` check

oracles: compatibility floor: authority-free reap_worktree removes+deregisters, second call is a False no-op, failed ops.remove retains the entry (passes BOTH pre-port and post-port)
an authority whose token no longer classifies current/expired refuses and never calls ops.remove
preflight ordering: instrumented preflight and mutation phases prove the refusal precedes _reap_prevalidated and ops.remove, with registry bytes unchanged
prune prevalidates before the graph mutation: a refused prune leaves nodes, spec_revision, registry, and lease intact
prune of a lease-bound worktree without authority refuses instead of stranding the lease
production_worktree_processor threads a real broker through provision -> terminal reap, releasing the exact lease
production_worktree_processor with no explicit authority resolves lease_broker.broker() and injects THAT
main() advance hands advance a worktree_processor that reaches reconcile_worktree_leases with the resolved authority
main() prune passes outcome_dispatcher.default_lease_authority() into the decompose prune seam
release_authority=False retains the broker lease across a successful reap
a legacy entry with no lease binding degrades to an empty-lease_id preflight and reaps with no release
second reap under authority is idempotent: no raise, no second removal, no double release
malformed receipt (null / missing fields / foreign authority root) refuses at preflight before removal
a corrupt registry surfaces via read_registry_strict without quarantining or rewriting it
TOCTOU: a registry mutated between prevalidation and mutation refuses the stale proof
removal failure retains BOTH the registry entry and the unreleased lease, and surfaces as reap_failed
authority-release failure (raise and False-return) does not mark the reap successful and surfaces as reap_failed
reconcile_worktree_leases adopts a legacy live entry under a broker lease
